captureProtocol: capture.cjs fixed-coordinate sweep, then click Tab ArrowRight Home Escape and exit
limitations: Live deployed SHA unknown; source checkout SHA is not assigned to live captures.
Source and candidate component widths differ.
Live candle and order-book ticks are not synchronized.
Recording starts after the initial reveal.
Fixed coordinates miss some chart-specific targets.
WebM reported cadence is 25 FPS, not the requested 30 FPS or required 60 FPS.
After is the earlier repair build. After-final includes volume-area and exact candle-fill repairs.
No light, reduced-motion, per-example, or full-state proof is certified.
